title: Subjunctive: first signals
subtitle: Notice long-vowel forms in a dependent clause.
overview: The present subjunctive often uses long-vowel connecting forms: λύωμεν, λύητε, λύωσιν.
The form alone does not tell the full meaning; first find the word that governs the clause.

sections.title: Present active subjunctive
rows: that we may loose; let us loose
